 Tulane Football travel plans to Houston altered due to nationwide ground stop 
 Green Wave set to face Rice in Houston, TX on Saturday 
 Tulane Green Wave fans celebrate historic College Football Playoff berth (WVUE) By Madeline Adams Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 7:39 PM CST | Updated : 19 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google NEW ORLEANS (WVUE) - The Tulane football team is now taking buses to Houston, Texas ahead of their Saturday matchup against the Rice Owls. The team left their on-campus facility around 7:30 p.m. Friday night. 
 The Green Wave originally planned to fly and was on the runway waiting to take off when the nationwide ground stop went into effect. 
 Tulane now makes the roughly 5.5 hour drive to Houston. The game against Rice was set for 1:00 p.m. on Saturday but had been pushed back to 3:30 p.m. due to the nationwide ground stop.
